scenario: Prune a reserve-sweep duplicate from the queue only after late account, bank, operations, and exception records all converge on the same pending instruction.
user_instruction: Please complete the reserve-sweep queue review for transfer TR-8450. Start from account flag note AF-845, then use bank letter BL-845, ops follow-up OP-845, exception approval EX-845, transfer policy TR-8450, account holds for ACC-8450, and approval AP-845. If those records still identify the same duplicate reserve-sweep instruction, finish only the queue-pruning step.

finance_account_flag_notes.body_text: Account flag note AF-845. Reserve sweep review remains open on ACC-8450. Queue pruning is allowed only if late-arriving bank and operations records still identify one duplicate pending instruction.

finance_bank_letter_texts.body_text: Bank letter BL-845. The reserve sweep stop applies to queued instruction PTX-845D on account ACC-8450.

finance_ops_followup_messages.body_text: Ops follow-up OP-845. Duplicate reserve sweep cleanup still targets PTX-845D if policy and approval remain aligned.

finance_exception_approvals.body_text: Exception approval EX-845. Queue pruning remains authorized only for the duplicate reserve-sweep instruction identified in the bank and account records.

finance_transfer_policies.body_text: Transfer policy TR-8450. If the reserve-sweep duplicate is still uniquely identified across account, bank, and operations records, close the review by cancelling that queued transfer.

finance_account_holds.body_text: Review hold only. Queue cancellation is permitted during duplicate reserve-sweep cleanup.

finance_approval_memos.body_text: Approval AP-845. Duplicate reserve-sweep queue cleanup is approved for PTX-845D.
